body.x: NanoIT (CEO Ha Eun-min, www.nanoit.kr) showcased its “BMX 5000”, a bulk message transmission gateway, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
The product is a message transmission system for mobile push messages that require large-scale traffic and stability.

This system provides a multiplatform environment that is compatible with various IT solutions, all according to client companies’ diverse business aims. It also transmits information via customer DB and supports 1:N type message MT service.

The system can operate stably with transmission speeds of 5,000TPS, a dual-structured (Active to Active) transmission server, and six fault systems. It is highly efficient as it uses a web-based transmission method. Users can rent a text message transmission site to run this, which means no construction of additional sites is needed.
This is a smart, hybrid message system developed with the company’s own gateway technology and NPDB. It provides a stable messaging service at an affordable price.

NanoIT CEO Ha Eun-min said: “BMX 5000 is a hybrid bulk message transmission gateway that can handle both telecommunication and A2P messages. We will provide a stable system for a reasonable price to various global app service companies like O2O.”

DIP prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the reinforcement project for the quality capability of the smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
